opening.argument: The presentation promotes flash-loan arbitrage as a way to gain cryptocurrency through smart contracts, then ties that opportunity to a specific financial contribution: approximately 0.25 BNB for every 1000 BNB borrowed. It directs viewers to implement the contract and execute its action function, while reporting that the account had “almost doubled” its original BNB. Although it acknowledges that arbitration can fail and gas prices vary, those qualifications do not erase the concrete promotion of a high-return result linked to supplying BNB and following the instructed contract steps.
